note: 기존 레슨 보강(15분 기준). 원본 레슨은 그대로 두고 화면에서 합쳐 표시. 상태: AI 초안

vocabulary.example_en: Since you are here, let's start.
Even though it was late, the shop was open.

examples.en: We stayed inside because it was raining.
Although the test was difficult, she passed it.
Because the weather was nice, we walked to work.
He kept working although he felt sick.
Even though it was late, the shop was still open.
Since you are here, let's start the meeting.

questions.stem: ___ it rained all day, the game was not canceled.
questions.explanation_ko: 비가 왔는데도 취소되지 않았으니 대조의 although.

questions.stem: He went to bed early ___ he was very tired.
questions.explanation_ko: 피곤한 것이 일찍 잔 이유이므로 because.

questions.stem: ‘비록 ~이지만’이라는 뜻의 두 단어 표현을 쓰세요. (e로 시작)
questions.explanation_ko: even though는 although와 비슷하게 대조를 나타내요.
